cipher.name: FixedKeyboardRowShiftCipher
cipher.idea: Shift each letter to its immediate right neighbor on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, wrapping around to the start of the same row. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters (including digits, spaces, and punctuation) remain unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
For each alphabetic character, locate its position on its corresponding QWERTY keyboard row. Shift it one position to the right, wrapping around to the first letter of that row if it is the last letter. Maintain the original case. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.

Row mappings (case-insensitive for lookup, preserving case in output):
- Top Row: Q -> W -> E -> R -> T -> Y -> U -> I -> O -> P -> Q
- Middle Row: A -> S -> D -> F -> G -> H -> J -> K -> L -> A
- Bottom Row: Z -> X -> C -> V -> B -> N -> M -> Z
cipher.decrypt_rules:
For each alphabetic character, locate its position on its corresponding QWERTY keyboard row. Shift it one position to the left, wrapping around to the last letter of that row if it is the first letter. Maintain the original case. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.

Row mappings (case-insensitive for lookup, preserving case in output):
- Top Row: Q <- W <- E <- R <- T <- Y <- U <- I <- O <- P <- Q
- Middle Row: A <- S <- D <- F <- G <- H <- J <- K <- L <- A
- Bottom Row: Z <- X <- C <- V <- B <- N <- M <- Z
